term: first unmoved mover at a time
definition: The canonical predicates instantiated at one supplied time t: f moves something at t and is moved in no respect at t (IsFirstUnmovedMover (Moved t) (Moves t) f). It does not say that f is moved at no other time, and it is not IsFirstUnmovedMover of any time-free relation.
note: Analyst instantiation for #718. The prima via module reads its time-free vocabulary simul; which clock, if any, realizes that is open. Reality-facing examples, rivals and limits: docs/notes/temporal-actualization-fork.md. No source attribution.
